title: Training Notes: Part-Payment Share on Fleet Late Balance Fees
content:
These notes cover one rule of the fleet late balance fee on Vehicle Purchase Agreements of the Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement type: the part-payment share a buyer earns by paying down the deal.

**The rule.** A buyer who has paid down the deal earns a part-payment share.
- The buyer's own payments on the deal are every payment posted to the deal other than an applied deposit, lender funding or a manufacturer incentive, less any payment returned unpaid.
- Where they total **at least 50 percent (0.5)** of the deal's cash price, the share is **0.8 (80 percent)**.
- Where they total **at least 25 percent (0.25) but less than 50 percent** of the cash price, the share is **0.9 (90 percent)**.
- Otherwise no part-payment share applies.

**Q. Which payments count as the buyer's own?**
A. Every payment posted on the deal counts, except deposits applied to the deal at delivery, lender funding and the manufacturer fleet incentive. Any payment returned unpaid by the bank is taken back out of the total.

**Q. What is the total compared with?**
A. With the deal's cash price, which is the agreed selling price on the deal.

**Q. Where are the boundaries?**
A. Exactly half of the cash price already earns the 0.8 share. Exactly a quarter earns the 0.9 share. Anything short of a quarter earns no part-payment share.

**Hypothetical check (cash price 40,000.00)**

| Buyer's own payments | Part of cash price | Part-payment share |
|---|---|---|
| 20,000.00 | exactly 50 percent | 0.8 |
| 19,999.99 | just under 50 percent | 0.9 |
| 10,000.00 | exactly 25 percent | 0.9 |
| 9,999.99 | just under 25 percent | none |

**Hypothetical returned payment.** A buyer posts check payments of 12,000.00 on a 40,000.00 deal, and a 3,000.00 check is returned unpaid. The buyer's own payments are 9,000.00, which is under 25 percent, so no part-payment share applies.
